priceSnapshot.source: OKX Public API v5 (market/ticker), fetched via in-page fetch() from the okx.com origin using Claude in Chrome. WebFetch through the sandbox proxy returned a 403 for direct OKX calls and hallucinated when asked to extract large candle arrays, so all BTC price/candle/derivatives data this run was fetched and computed via in-page fetch() in the browser; WebFetch was used only for macro (Brent/DXY/US10Y), ETF flows, Fear&Greed, and non-crypto indices.
priceSnapshot.note: Today's morning session ran unusually late (generated 13:58 COT, ~12 minutes before this report) due to today's delayed scheduling -- so this midday snapshot is almost a continuation of it, not a fresh session gap. Morning's story: the range top cracked once (a confirmed 1H close at 84,724, 05:00 COT, above the old addIf 84,628.2) but the breakout failed to extend, wicking to 85,258.8 and fading back under 84,000. Price has barely moved since morning's report (83,963.3 -> 83,944.4, -0.02%), still sitting closer to the defended support than the twice-rejected resistance.

reduceIf.confirmation: A settled 1H close below 82,874.5 (unbroken since the Sep-24 flush; today's low 83,174.7 stayed well above it) would signal the recovery attempt failed and downside continuation is resuming.

addIf.confirmation: Carried from this morning: raised from 84,628.2 after that level saw one confirmed 1H close above it (84,724) that failed to extend. A settled 1H close above 84,944.4 -- which has now capped two separate attempts (the 84,724 close and the 85,258.8 wick) -- would confirm the range top is actually breaking, not just testing.

decisionBox.changed: No change from this morning: reduceIf (82,874.5) and the raised addIf (84,944.4) both carry forward untouched. Today's schedule ran a backlog: Sep-24 endday never fired, so midnight, morning, and this midday session all executed within about 20 minutes of each other, each with its own small spot DCA (midnight and morning). With price essentially flat across that whole window (-0.02% since morning) there is no new information to act on -- holding rather than trading a third time on the same read.

No dominant magnet either direction.
